# Attribute Create

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Create or overwrite one attribute from an expression.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "attribute", "name": "attribute", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `name` | `string` | `"value"` |  |
| `expression` | `expr` | `"0.0"` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `out` | `table` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->

## Remarks

Attribute Create adds a column, or replaces one, computed from an expression over the row's other columns: `[lng, lat]` makes a position, `sqrt(pop) * 2` a size. It is how a layer gets a per-row value; there are no accessor functions. Older projects' Accessor operators convert to it.

The expression compiles to SQL, to a CPU loop or to a GPU shader, whichever the planner finds cheapest for where its value goes. A parameter it reads with `ch('node/param')` is bound, not written into the expression, so dragging that parameter does not recompile the graph.

The name is the column's: letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or an underscore. A layer reads it by that name, as in a Scatterplot Layer's `position`.

## Examples

A size from a magnitude column, scaled by a slider:

```json
{
  "nodes": [
    { "id": "n1", "op": "number", "name": "scale", "x": 0, "y": 200, "params": { "value": 2 } },
    { "id": "n2", "op": "attribute", "name": "size", "x": 300, "y": 0, "params": { "name": "size", "expression": "sqrt(mag) * ch('scale/value')" } }
  ],
  "edges": []
}
```

## Older projects

Projects saved before documents used operator classes. These convert to `attribute` when they open: `AccessorOp`, `DateFormatOp`, `DateMathOp`, `DatePartsOp`.
<!-- gen:end history -->
